query: What strategies are there for reporting a hospital employee who insists on receiving gifts in exchange for services?
reference_answer:
Reporting Bribery Demands:
To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department (DVAC) or the local police station. You can also call the toll-free helpline 1064 or file a complaint online on the TN Government website.
answer: To report a hospital employee who accepts gifts for services, approach Human Resources (HR) with documented evidence of the incidents. Follow their procedures for reporting suspected misconduct. [Document 1]
